RFSweepMeasurementDescription.description: A set of descriptive properties of the measurement

system.description: Designation for measurement system (i.e. system A, B, etc)

water_bath_temperature.description: Temperature of the water bath in Celsius.

calorimeter_name.description: Name of the calorimeter being used.

DUT_name.description: Name of the device under test (DUT) inside the microcalorimeter.

thermal_ref_name.description: Name of the device used as a thermal reference (if applicable).

monitor_name.description: Name of the sidearm (S3) inside the microcalorimeter.

RF_source_name.description: Name of the sidearm (S3) inside the microcalorimeter.

splitter_name.description: Name of the splitter being used

DC_source_type.description: What type of DC source is being used to bias the DUT (if applicable)

RF_source_type.description: What type of DC source is being used to bias the DUT (if applicable)

lead_resistance.description: Resistance of DC lead connected to the DUT (usually zero).
